projects.name: Music Distribution Platform
projects.summary: Platform for label operations and music distribution, in active development since November 2025. End-to-end designed and built with focus on stability, maintainability, and operational safety. Feature-based architecture with feature toggles enables safe iteration and prevents cascading failures. System complexity absorbed during design phase—appears simple as result of correct architectural decisions.

projects.name: Portfolio Website
projects.summary: Personal portfolio built with modern web technologies. Features custom cursor interactions, parallax effects, and functional contact form with automated email delivery. Comprehensive test coverage (156 tests) following SOLID principles with modular architecture. CI/CD pipeline with automated testing and deployment.
